authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 43 akṣi includes Awankari akh, Maiyan āc̣hi/ãc̣hi and Western Pahari aċh eye. These survey velar and affricate forms match the regional eye family; phonetic x represents the spirant counterpart of kh. Exact survey form ax is retained.
